correctness.rationale: On aZ all magnitude discrepancies vanish. On bεZ, the squared-modulus difference is ±2ρ sin(πεk); rationalization yields 2π|k|ρ/sqrt(1+ρ²). Uniform Gaussian envelopes dominate sum/integral for |ε|<1/2, giving Δ²/ε²→4π² I(a) S_m(a). Inner product of translated normalized Gaussians gives distance 2sqrt(1−exp(−π/(2a²))). An independent numerical reconstruction at a=1/2,m=1 confirmed C≈0.683705172855.
